description: Figure 5 illustrates the percentage performance gain on tasks achieved through predictive rollout search, comparing VisuoThink with and without rollout search. The horizontal axis displays task categories labeled “Geometry,” “Spatial Reasoning,” and “Overall,” presented in that order. The vertical axis, labeled “Performance Gain (%)”, employs a linear scale ranging from 0 to 60, with tick marks at 0, 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, and 60. Three bars are presented, one for each task category. The “Geometry” bar is light blue and extends to approximately 20%. The “Spatial Reasoning” bar is also light blue and reaches approximately 40%. The “Overall” bar, also light blue, extends to approximately 30%. The bars are not visually emphasized beyond their color and height, and are arranged alphabetically by task category.
